answer: A sybil operator reuses one script across a thousand shells, so cost must attach to a history that cannot be copied. Each claimant must wander a verifier-seeded route down a branching river graph for thirty daily legs: the next fork is revealed only after it commits the prior leg's observation, chaining each step to the last. A pearl marker at the delta is minted only for a complete, unbroken chain. One transcript cannot serve two identities because their revealed forks diverge, and shortcuts cannot be precomputed; faking N agents means walking N separate rivers leg by leg.
